FluentMusic v1.3.6 Ultimate Overhaul:
- Priority 1 & 2 lyrics pipeline (YouLy+ & BetterLyrics) with Apple TTML syllable parsing and word glow sweep
- Liquid Glass dynamic Clear/Tinted optics slider with text refraction preview card
- Player lyrics mode double-header collision eliminated with native iOS pull-down grabber handle
- Real-time lyrics timing sync offset (±250ms) and playback speed/pitch audio presets
- Playlist page redesigned with native liquid_glass_widgets (GlassChip, GlassButton, GlassIconButton, GlassSearchBar)
- Light Mode high-contrast text and UI visibility fixes
- Studio track priority ranking over unofficial live clips
- Splash screen initialization deadlock 4s fail-safe fix
- New 1024px launcher icon mipmaps and branding assets
